'''Aorth-6''' was a biologically engineered necrotic virus that, once inhaled in gaseous form, liquefied the [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] and spread out to the rest of its victims' bodies to melt them from the inside out. The gas was ineffective against those who possessed artificial respirators in lieu of an organic respiratory system.

During [[Ghost Prison incident|the coup]] of [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]], his most distinguished [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]]&mdash;whom he called his "Future [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]]"&mdash;released the gas in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] many unsuspecting [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself was infected, but kept his body intact through his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|connection]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Because their respiratory systems were artificial, neither [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]] nor the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were affected by the virus when they came to the Emperor's rescue.
